The first native-search attempt used the system search controller. UIKit re-showed its Cancel X after animation, and keyboard transitions shifted the list under the status bar. That workaround was removed. The final native text field requires neither cancellation-event suppression nor delayed hide commands. Keyboard avoidance is scoped to the iOS header search; other inputs retain the prior list keyboard handling.

Source validation at the final source: 432 mobile tests passed, 8 skipped; mobile typecheck, repository lint/policies and changelog validation passed. Focused regressions cover immediate query updates, retention on drawer dismissal, search retention through reset, and clearing without dismissal. Two-axis source review found no remaining actionable Standards or Spec finding; native limitations remain separate. Earlier Host/query/CLI and CI evidence is historical and linked in the PR, not claimed as current-head CI.

No Simulator erase/rebuild or physical-phone use. The original shared Host and its seven pending approvals must remain intact. Task cleanup and lane release are recorded in the PR QA comment.
